HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Religious? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Religious.
   B. Use Religious to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Religious with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Religious has no place in daily life.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Myself? (1 mark)
   A. Say Myself has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Myself to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Myself with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Myself.

3. Which response best shows understanding of Specific morning? (1 mark)
   A. Use Specific morning to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Specific morning.
   C. Say Specific morning has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Specific morning with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Qualities of? (1 mark)
   A. Use Qualities of to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Qualities of.
   C. Say Qualities of has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Qualities of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Refusing to help a neighbour
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

6. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Waste food daily
   D. Destroy trees without planting

7. Which response best shows understanding of General Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Say General Etiquette has no place in daily life.
   B. Use General Etiquette to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing General Etiquette.
   D. Apply the teaching of General Etiquette with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada? (1 mark)
   A. Use Kalpasutra and Dhammapada to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Kalpasutra and Dhammapada.
   C. Say Kalpasutra and Dhammapada has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Kalpasutra and Dhammapada with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Pranayam? (1 mark)
   A. Use Pranayam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pranayam.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pranayam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pranayam has no place in daily life.

10. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Religious and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Myself and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Specific morning and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Qualities of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kalpasutra and Dhammapada and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Pranayam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain General Etiquette and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
